rows.text_en: Ministry of Health and Welfare ( Self-Reliance Support Division for Persons with Disabilities ), 044-202-3325, 3330

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「중증장애인생산품 우선구매 특별법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Special Act on the Priority Purchase of Products Produced by Severely Disabled Persons and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제1조의2(중증장애인의 범위) 「중증장애인생산품 우선구매 특별법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제2조제1항에서 “보건복지부령으로 정하는 자”란 「장애인복지법 시행규칙」 별표 1에 따른 장애의 정도가 심한 장애인을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-2 (Scope of Persons with Severe Disabilities) In Article 2, Paragraph 1 of the Special Act on Priority Purchase of Products Made by Persons with Severe Disabilities (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the term “person prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” refers to a person with a severe degree of disability as set forth in Annex 1 of the Enforcement Rules of the Welfare Act for Persons with Disabilities.

[This Article was newly added on May 27, 2020.]
[Formerly Article 1-2 was moved to Article 1-3 <May 27, 2020>]

rows.source_ko: 제1조의3(실태조사의 범위 및 방법 등) ① 법 제5조의2제1항에 따른 실태조사(이하 “실태조사”라 한다)에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2020. 5. 27.>
rows.text_en: Article 1-3 (Scope and Method, etc. of Fact-Finding Survey) ① The fact-finding survey under Article 5-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “fact-finding survey”) shall include the matters of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended May 27, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 공공기관의 제품 및 노무용역 등의 서비스(중증장애인생산품을 포함한다) 구매에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the purchase of products and services, such as labor services (including products made by severely disabled persons), by public institutions

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제2조제2항에 따른 중증장애인생산품 생산시설(이하 “생산시설”이라 한다)의 장애인 고용ㆍ임금, 생산 과정ㆍ설비 및 매출액 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the employment and wages of persons with disabilities, production processes, facilities, and sales revenue, etc. of production facilities for products made by persons with severe disabilities pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 2 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “production facilities”)

rows.source_ko: 3. 법 제11조에 따른 중증장애인생산품업무수행기관이나 「장애인복지법 시행령」 제36조에 따른 장애인 생산품판매시설이 법 제7조제4항에 따라 실시한 수의계약 대행에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the delegation of private contracts conducted pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 4 of the Act by an agency performing duties regarding products made by persons with severe disabilities under Article 11 of the Act or a sales facility for products made by persons with disabilities under Article 36 of the Enforcement Decree of the Welfare Act for Persons with Disabilities.

rows.source_ko: 4. 「장애인복지법 시행령」 제36조에 따른 장애인 생산품판매시설의 중증장애인생산품 판매에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the sale of products made by severely disabled persons at facilities selling products made by disabled persons pursuant to Article 36 of the Enforcement Decree of the Welfare Act for Persons with Disabilities

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 보건복지부장관이 중증장애인생산품 우선구매 정책의 수립ㆍ시행을 위하여 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Health and Welfare for the establishment and implementation of the policy on the preferential purchase of products made by severely disabled persons

rows.source_ko: ② 실태조사는 현장조사, 문헌조사, 서면조사 및 통계조사 등의 방법으로 실시하며, 필요한 경우에는 정보통신망 또는 전자우편 등의 전자적 방식을 사용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The status survey shall be conducted using methods such as field surveys, literature reviews, written surveys, and statistical surveys, and if necessary, electronic methods such as information and communication networks or e-mail may be used.

rows.source_ko: ③ 보건복지부장관은 3년마다 실태조사를 실시하되, 사회 환경의 급격한 변동 등으로 추가적인 조사가 필요한 경우에는 임시조사를 실시하여 실태조사를 보완할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Health and Welfare shall conduct a survey on the actual situation every three years, but may supplement the survey on the actual situation by conducting a temporary survey if additional surveys are necessary due to rapid changes in the social environment, etc.

rows.source_ko: ④ 보건복지부장관은 실태조사의 전부 또는 일부를 법 제11조제1항에 따른 중증장애인생산품업무수행기관이나 중증장애인생산품 우선구매 촉진에 관한 전문성, 인력 및 장비를 갖춘 기관ㆍ법인 또는 단체에 의뢰하여 실시할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Minister of Health and Welfare may commission all or part of the fact-finding survey to an agency performing duties on products made by severely disabled persons pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Act , or to an institution, corporation, or organization equipped with expertise, personnel, and equipment regarding the promotion of priority purchasing of products made by severely disabled persons.

[This Article was newly added on Sep. 14, 2018]
[Moved from Article 1-2 on May 27, 2020>]

rows.source_ko: 제2조(중증장애인생산품 구매계획의 제출) 공공기관의 장은 법 제7조의2제1항에 따른 중증장애인생산품 우선구매관리시스템(이하 “우선구매관리시스템”이라 한다)을 통하여 「중증장애인생산품 우선구매 특별법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제10조제1항에 따른 중증장애인생산품 구매실적과 중증장애인생산품 구매계획을 보건복지부장관에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2018. 9. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Submission of Purchase Plan for Products Made by Persons with Severe Disabilities) The head of a public institution shall submit to the Minister of Health and Welfare the purchase performance of products made by persons with severe disabilities and the purchase plan for products made by persons with severe disabilities pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Priority Purchase of Products Made by Persons with Severe Disabilities (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) through the Priority Purchase Management System for Products Made by Persons with Severe Disabilities pursuant to Article 7-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Priority Purchase Management System”). <Amended Sep. 14, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(우선구매관리시스템의 운영) ① 보건복지부장관은 법 제7조의2제3항에 따라 생산시설의 장에게 다음 각 호의 사항을 우선구매관리시스템에 입력하도록 요청할 수 있다. <개정 2018. 9. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Operation of Preferential Purchasing Management System) ① The Minister of Health and Welfare may request the head of a production facility to input the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs into the Preferential Purchasing Management System pursuant to Article 7-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act. <Amended Sep. 14, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 생산시설 근로자 현황
rows.text_en: 1. Status of Production Facility Workers

rows.source_ko: 2. 생산설비 현황
rows.text_en: 2. Status of Production Facilities

rows.source_ko: 3. 중증장애인생산품 판매 내역
rows.text_en: 3. Sales history of products made by people with severe disabilities

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 보건복지부장관이 생산시설 관련 정보의 수집ㆍ관리ㆍ제공을 위하여 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Health and Welfare for the collection, management, and provision of information related to production facilities

rows.source_ko: ② 생산시설의 장은 제1항에 따라 입력한 정보가 변경된 경우에는 지체 없이 그 내용을 우선구매관리시스템에 반영하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If the information entered pursuant to Paragraph 1 is changed, the head of the production facility shall reflect the details in the priority purchasing management system without delay.

rows.source_ko: 제3조의2(중증장애인생산품 구매계획 및 구매실적의 공표 기준ㆍ방법) ① 보건복지부장관은 법 제7조의3제1항에 따라 중증장애인생산품 구매계획과 전년도 구매실적을 종합하여 매년 4월 30일까지 이를 공표하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Standards and Methods for Publicizing Purchase Plans and Purchase Performance of Products Made by Severely Disabled Persons) ① The Minister of Health and Welfare shall compile the purchase plans for products made by severely disabled persons and the purchase performance of the previous year pursuant to Article 7-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act and publish them by April 30 of each year.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 전년도 구매실적에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The purchase performance of the previous year pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall include the following items:

rows.source_ko: 1. 중증장애인생산품을 포함한 제품과 노무용역 등의 서비스(공사는 제외한다)에 대한 총구매액
rows.text_en: 1. Total purchase amount for products including those made by severely disabled persons and services such as labor services (excluding construction).

rows.source_ko: 2. 중증장애인생산품 구매액
rows.text_en: 2. Purchase amount of products made by severely disabled people

rows.source_ko: 3. 총구매액에 대한 중증장애인생산품 구매비율
rows.text_en: 3. Purchase ratio of products made by severely disabled persons relative to total purchase amount

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 공표 방법은 관보에 게재하거나 보건복지부의 인터넷 홈페이지에 3개월 동안 게시하는 것으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The method of publication pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall be publication in the Official Gazette or posting on the Ministry of Health and Welfare’s website for three months.
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 14, 2018]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(생산시설의 지정 신청 등) ① 영 제17조제2항에 따른 중증장애인생산품 생산시설 지정 신청서 및 영 제17조제3항에 따른 재지정 신청서는 별지 제1호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Application for Designation of Production Facility, etc.) ① The application for designation of a production facility for products made by severely disabled persons pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree and the application for re-designation pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항의 신청서에는 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여야 한다. 다만, 재지정을 신청하는 경우에는 제1호의 서류를 생략할 수 있다. <개정 2017. 5. 30., 2019. 9. 27.>
rows.text_en: ② The application form under Paragraph 1 shall be accompanied by the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. However, in the case of an application for re-designation, the document specified in Subparagraph 1 may be omitted. <Amended May 30, 2017; September 27, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 서류 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of any of the following documents

rows.source_ko: 가. 「장애인복지법」 제63조에 따른 장애인복지단체의 설립허가증(법인인 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: a. Certificate of establishment of a welfare organization for persons with disabilities pursuant to Article 63 of the Welfare Act for Persons with Disabilities (applicable only to corporations)

rows.source_ko: 나. 「장애인복지법 시행규칙」 제43조제5항에 따른 장애인복지시설 신고증
rows.text_en: B. Certificate of Reporting for Welfare Facilities for Persons with Disabilities pursuant to Article 43, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Rules of the Welfare Act for Persons with Disabilities

rows.source_ko: 다. 「정신건강증진 및 정신질환자 복지서비스 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙」 제17조제4항에 따른 정신재활시설 설치신고확인증
rows.text_en: C. Confirmation of notification of establishment of a mental rehabilitation facility pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Rule of the Act on Promotion of Mental Health and Support for Welfare Services for Persons with Mental Illness

rows.source_ko: 2. 근로자 명부 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of the employee roster

rows.source_ko: 3. 근로자 임금대장 1부
rows.text_en: 3. One copy of the employee wage ledger

rows.source_ko: 4. 정관 또는 규약 사본 1부
rows.text_en: 4. One copy of the Articles of Incorporation or Bylaws

rows.source_ko: 제5조(생산시설의 지정 등) ① 영 제17조제6항에 따른 중증장애인생산품 생산시설 지정서는 별지 제2호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Designation of Production Facilities, etc.) ① The designation certificate for production facilities for products made by severely disabled persons pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 2.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제17조제8항에 따른 중증장애인생산품 생산시설 지정서의 재발급 신청서는 별지 제3호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The application for reissuance of a designation certificate for a production facility for products made by severely disabled persons pursuant to Article 17 , Paragraph 8 of the Enforcement Decree is in the form of Annex 3 .

rows.source_ko: ③ 중증장애인생산품 생산시설의 지정을 받은 자는 생산품이나 생산품의 포장 또는 홍보물 등에 별표의 중증장애인생산품 생산시설 표시를 붙이거나 사용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ A person who has been designated as a production facility for products made by severely disabled persons may attach or use the mark of the production facility for products made by severely disabled persons as shown in the attached table on the products, packaging, or promotional materials .

rows.source_ko: 제6조(현장조사서) 법 제18조제3항에서 “보건복지부령으로 정하는 사항이 기재된 서류”란 별지 제4호서식의 현장조사서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Field Investigation Report) In Article 18, Paragraph 3 of the Act, the phrase “document containing matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” refers to the field investigation report in Form No. 4 of the Attached Form.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Health and Welfare Decree No. 420, July 20, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 2016년 8월 4일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall take effect on August 4, 2016.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <보건복지부령 제497호, 2017. 5. 30.> (정신건강증진 및 정신질환자 복지서비스 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Health and Welfare Decree No. 497, May 30, 2017> (Enforcement Rule of the Act on Promotion of Mental Health and Support for Welfare Services for Persons with Mental Illness)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 2017년 5월 30일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on May 30, 2017.

rows.source_ko: 제2조 부터 제10조까지 생략
rows.text_en: Articles 2  through 10 omitted

rows.source_ko: 제11조(다른 법령의 개정) ①부터 ⑩까지 생략
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① through ⑩ Omitted

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 중증장애인생산품 우선구매 특별법 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: 11. The Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on Priority Purchase of Products Made by Severely Disabled Persons are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제4조제2항제1호다목을 다음과 같이 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 1, Item (c) shall be as follows.

rows.source_ko: 다. 「정신건강증진 및 정신질환자 복지서비스 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙」 제17조제4항에 따른 정신재활시설 설치신고필증
rows.text_en: C. Certificate of Notification for the Establishment of a Mental Rehabilitation Facility pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Rule of the Act on Promotion of Mental Health and Support for Welfare Services for Persons with Mental Illness

rows.source_ko: ⑫ 생략
rows.text_en: 12 Omitted

rows.source_ko: 제12조 생략
rows.text_en: Article 12  Omitted

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 2018년 9월 14일부터 시행한다. 다만, 별지 제1호서식의 개정규정은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall enter into force on September 14, 2018. However, the amended provisions of Form No. 1 attached hereto shall enter into force on the date of promulgation.

rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Health and Welfare Decree No. 672, Sep. 27, 2019> (Ministry of Health and Welfare Decree on the Partial Amendment of 48 Laws for the Standardization of Difficult Legal Terms)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 2020년 5월 27일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on May 27, 2020.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(중증장애인생산품 생산시설 지정서에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 전에 종전의 규정에 따라 발급된 중증장애인생산품 생산시설 지정서는 별지 제2호서식의 개정규정에 따라 발급된 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Designation Certificates for Production Facilities of Products Made by Severely Disabled Persons)  Designation Certificates for Production Facilities of Products Made by Severely Disabled Persons issued prior to the enforcement of this Rule in accordance with the previous regulations shall be deemed to have been issued in accordance with the amended regulations of Form No. 2 attached hereto.
